remarks: Rare opportunity to build new directly on the sand at Big Rock Beach. Plans and permits are in the final stages of approval with the City of Malibu offering a significantly accelerated path to building a brand-new beachfront home. The proposed residence features approximately 3,314 square feet of living space with 3 bedrooms and 3 bathrooms, plus an impressive 1,029 square feet of decks designed to maximize indoor-outdoor living and take full advantage of the extraordinary setting. Set on a 4,271 square foot lot with approximately 48 feet of beachfront frontage, the property offers sweeping Pacific Ocean views and direct access to the sand.
